Task H9: Cursor pagination with ties

Implement pages.list_page(items, cursor, size) -> (page, next_cursor). Order: score descending, then id ascending (ids are unique strings). cursor None means the first page; next_cursor is None after the last page. Walking all pages must return every item exactly once even when many items share a score. The cursor is an opaque string that must not contain titles or other item data besides score and id. size < 1 or a malformed cursor raises ValueError. Do not modify items.

Work only inside the supplied workspace. Use Python standard library only. Inspect the files, implement the requirements, run available checks, and give a short final report describing changes and checks actually performed. Do not modify TASK.md, smoke.py or the evaluation infrastructure. Do not install packages or access the internet. Do not claim a check passed without running it.
